Quote <@U03JDJWSR> news by email :
I've managed to arrange a 3D printer (for the Open-BCI headset) with-in a Lab (who are working on some really interesting projects) of my University and the team who is looking after this whole Lab has showed a great interest in my project and the 'CogLab' itself. They are now just waiting to print it out, but I would like have a short meeting with my team (you guys - the CogLab) and them before proceeding with the Printing thing (in order to further understand their interest and how we can help each other).
